reason: Primary purpose is a DSH safety/guardrail plugin that protects critical harness files by intercepting write/edit operations, taking local snapshots before denied changes, and exposing CLI recovery commands (status, backup, restore, repair, one-time approval). It is a local filesystem safety utility for workflow reliability and recovery.

capabilities: intercepts file write/edit intents to protected paths
blocks destructive mutations to critical runtime directories by default
creates local snapshots of protected files before denied writes
provides CLI commands for backup, restore, status, repair, and one-time write approval

reasons.code: Repository README states the plugin hard-blocks fs/write-intent and fs/edit-intent on DSH critical paths and returns FS_POLICY_DENIED.
README describes local backup-before-destroy behavior, with snapshots stored under <DSH_HOME>/safety-net/backups and restore operations.
Package metadata declares plugin bundle wiring for the DeepSeek Harness and no external network service integrations.
